name: orchplus
summary: ORCH+ for Tern: durable per-session controller ownership, managed dispatch of coordinators and workers through SPAWN, structured report mailboxes and owner gates, verified worker and coordinator rollover, a per-target landing queue, guided reload recovery and optional USAGE quota routing. Effects run at most once and recovery fails closed.
way_in: Open ORCH+ Config button in the Files pane header (opens Config) or the ORCH+ palette command (opens the controller).
scope: Host-local: the controller, coordinator, workers, mailboxes and SPAWN records live on one Tern host. To orchestrate agents on a remote host, attach a Tern window to that host and open ORCH+ there. No SSH hop, no transcript reading.
